en: A black-and-white image showing a street parade with a large crowd gathered on both sides. The focal point is an ox-drawn float carrying people in costume depicting the Nativity of Christ, with a sign reading 'Gloria in Excelsis Deo.' The buildings in the background have European architectural features, and the crowd is dressed in early 20th-century European fashion. The caption at the bottom is in French and Dutch.
